template.title: Purpose
template.prompt: Say in one sentence what this runbook is for and who runs it.

template.title: Before the launch
template.prompt: List the checks to finish the day before. Give an owner for each.

template.title: During the launch
template.prompt: Write the watch list: the numbers to look at and how often.

template.title: When it goes wrong
template.prompt: Describe the first three actions for the most likely failure.

template.title: Who to call
template.prompt: Name the roles to call, in order, with a time limit for each.

template.title: After the launch
template.prompt: Say what to record and when the team meets to review it.

reference_example.situation: The invented studio Brightwick Mills launches a new filter pack for its Lumenfold app on Friday at noon.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: This runbook guides the on-call engineer through the Friday filter pack launch of Lumenfold.

sections.title: Before the launch
sections.body: Thursday: run the load test at twice last launch's peak (owner: Mara). Thursday: confirm rollback works in staging (owner: Tobias).

sections.title: During the launch
sections.body: Watch upload latency and the age of the oldest queued photo every five minutes for the first two hours.

sections.title: When it goes wrong
sections.body: First turn off the new filter pack with the flag. Second add resize workers. Third post a status note to followers.

sections.title: Who to call
sections.body: Call the on-call engineer first, then the product owner after 15 minutes, then the studio lead after 30 minutes.

sections.title: After the launch
sections.body: Record peak rate, worst queue age and actions taken. Meet on Monday to review the notes.

review_checklist: Check that the purpose fits in one sentence.
Confirm every pre-launch check has an owner.
Verify the watch list gives a number and a frequency.
Check that the first action for a failure is the quickest one to undo.
Confirm the call order has a time limit for each role.
Check that the review meeting has a date.
